data: New post — using video models to learn robot actions

Using video models to learn robot actions covers offline SO-101 experiments with Cosmos and LTX feature extraction, task video fine-tuning, and early representation-distillation experiments. It includes a base/fine-tuned/ground-truth video comparison and discusses what the recorded action errors and extraction timings do—and do not—establish.
Published two companion blog posts on real-robot reinforcement learning with the SO-101 arm — a technical overview and an experiment diary covering seven months of work.
Showcased Regulaido at the health.tech Global Summit in Basel, including our new Systematic Literature Review module for PubMed search, screening, and extraction.
Poster at DIA 2026 on agentic AI for regulatory writing
Presented a poster at DIA 2026 on agentic AI workflows for regulatory medical writing with Pharos Labs.
Presented Regulaido at BPI Lifecycles with a live demo of AI-assisted regulatory writing. Great discussions on referencing, hallucination prevention, and security architecture with pharma teams.
Talk at GDG Hamburg: Medical Writers Shouldn't Type. Coders Shouldn't Code.
Gave a talk at Google Developer Groups Hamburg’s “From Code to Cure” event on AI-assisted professional workflows in medical writing and software development.
BioCog delirium prediction paper published in British Journal of Anaesthesia

Our paper on predicting postoperative delirium using gradient-boosted trees was published in the British Journal of Anaesthesia. The algorithm achieves AUC 0.83 by combining preoperative and precipitating factors.
Two posters at ISPOR Europe 2025 in Glasgow

Presented two posters at ISPOR Europe 2025 in Glasgow with Pharos Labs — one on mapping 12,500 writer-AI conversations for HTA, and one on how professional identity shapes GenAI adoption among medical writers.
Smoking behaviours paper published in Addiction Biology
Our paper on machine learning classification of smoking behaviours — from social environment to the prefrontal cortex — was published in Addiction Biology.
Plazmapunk, our AI-powered music video generator, surpassed 100,000 creators on the platform.
Shunt prediction paper published in Journal of Clinical Monitoring and Computing
Our paper on early prediction of VP shunt dependency in subarachnoid haemorrhage patients using recurrent neural networks was published in the Journal of Clinical Monitoring and Computing.
Joined PHAROS Labs as an A.I. consultant to revolutionize the medical writing world!
